$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-gates).

Stats.$why: Figma draws the rule above it as a separate 1 px Separator; the code draws it as a top border, so it is 1 px taller (the card's size is compared).

WAITING ON YOU.$why: The column hugs its words, whose widths follow the font; the padding and gap are compared.

RUN.$why: The column hugs its words, whose widths follow the font; the padding and gap are compared.

Arguments.$why: Figma stacks the lines 2 px apart inside 8 px padding; the code's <pre> uses a 2 px taller line and 1 px less padding, which puts every line in the same place (the box's size is compared).

Arguments/TEXT.$why: Figma stacks the lines 2 px apart inside 8 px padding; the code's <pre> uses a 2 px taller line and 1 px less padding, which puts every line in the same place (the box's size is compared).

Actions.$why: Figma draws the rule above it as a separate 1 px Separator; the code draws it as a top border, so it is 1 px taller (the card's size is compared).

Behind 1.$why: Figma's strip is an empty auto-layout frame; the code draws it as a plain span.

Behind 2.$why: Figma's strip is an empty auto-layout frame; the code draws it as a plain span.

Reason.$why: Figma's Reason is an auto-layout frame around one text; the code's paragraph has no gap.

Run stopped.$why: Figma wraps the message in a Message frame with the padding; the code's panel carries it itself (compared on Message).

All decided.$why: Figma wraps the line in a Done frame with the padding; the code's card carries it itself (compared on Done).
